name: Cryptid Catch
source:
You find yourself washed up on the riverbank in an unknown area with strange beings everywhere you look! Help and befriend different American terrors from The Mad Gasser of Mattoon to The Beast of Bladenboro and all in between. Do you have what it takes to earn their trust?

In this very short visual novel you are able to talk to and meet with six differnt cryptids. 

[From [url=https://luckyowlm.itch.io/cryptid-catch]Itch.io[/url]]
